title: Guest Information at Eco Palms House
subtitle: Detailed guide for a comfortable and safe stay

hotWater.title: Using Hot Water
hotWater.step1: Turn the faucet handle to the left and wait about 3-5 minutes.
hotWater.step2: On cold days, hot water may flow slower, please be patient.

roomDesign.title: Room Design & Amenities
roomDesign.ecoStyle: Eco Palms House is built in an ecotourism style to help you experience natural tranquility, so there is no TV or refrigerator in the room.
roomDesign.noLaundry: Please do not wash or hang clothes in the room to avoid mold and protect the furniture.
roomDesign.beanBag: Please keep the bean bag dry; if it gets wet, it is very difficult to clean and may incur a special cleaning fee of

towels.title: Towels
towels.purpose: White towels are prepared specifically for bathing and personal use.
towels.warning: If used for other purposes (cleaning floors, shoes, pets…), the towels may be damaged beyond cleaning. In that case, we must charge a replacement fee of

electrical.title: Electrical Devices
electrical.safety: For safety reasons, please do not use high-power electrical devices (such as rice cookers, stoves, or hair dryers you brought).
electrical.turnOff: When going out, please remember to turn off all electrical devices to save energy and ensure safety.

fire.title: Fire Safety
fire.material: The bungalows are made from natural materials and are quite sensitive to fire.
fire.warning: Therefore, please do not smoke, light candles, or use fire in the room.
fire.emergency: If there is an emergency, please notify the staff immediately.

food.title: Food in Room
food.warning: Please do not bring food into the room. Food crumbs will attract "uninvited guests" 🐭. Who knows, a mouse might come to your room for a photoshoot, become an idol, then take over the world and dominate the universe 🌌.

insects.title: Insects & Natural Environment
insects.nature: In a place close to nature, small insects may occasionally appear.
insects.prevention: You can minimize this by closing doors and turning off unnecessary lights.

services.title: Popular Services at Eco Palms House

cableCar.title: Fansipan Cable Car Tickets
cableCar.description: Skip the queue, our reception will help you book official tickets quickly.

services.massageDescription: Great choice after trekking trips, helps the body recover faster.

happyHour.title: Happy Hour – Cocktail & Beer
happyHour.description: Enjoy the sunset view over the valley with special offers:
happyHour.promotion: Buy 1 Get 1 Free for cocktails & beers on our menu

thanks.title: Thank you for choosing Eco Palms House!
thanks.message: We hope your stay brings you relaxing moments, closeness to nature and many memorable experiences 🌿
